items.title_zh: Thermo Fisher 技术解读：新型抗体需按分子结构调整纯化策略
items.summary: Thermo Fisher 9月1日的技术文章讨论双特异性抗体、抗体片段和 Fc 融合蛋白的纯化差异。Protein A 仍是常规 IgG 捕获的重要方法，但新分子格式可能需要亚结构域选择性亲和配基，并结合离子交换、疏水或混合模式层析控制聚集体及错配链。文章主张按分子设计工艺，并非宣布 Protein A 过时，也不是一款新树脂的上市公告。
items.summary_en: Thermo Fisher's September 1 technical article discusses purification of bispecific antibodies, fragments and Fc-fusion proteins. Protein A remains important for conventional IgG, while engineered formats may need subdomain-selective affinity approaches and polishing steps such as ion exchange, hydrophobic interaction or mixed-mode chromatography to manage aggregates and mispaired chains. The point is molecule-specific process design, not that Protein A is obsolete or that a new resin has been launched.

items.summary: 第一三共8月27日公布 TROPION-Urothelial04 研究首例给药。该全球 III 期试验评估抗 TROP2 ADC Dato-DXd 单药或联合 PD-1/TIGIT 双特异性抗体 rilvegostomig，用于接受术前治疗和手术后、复发风险较高的肌层浸润性尿路上皮癌患者。研究计划约915人，以无病生存期为主要终点。消息是试验启动，不是已证明优于标准治疗的结果。
items.summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced first dosing in TROPION-Urothelial04 on August 27. The global phase 3 trial evaluates the anti-TROP2 ADC Dato-DXd alone or with the PD-1/TIGIT bispecific rilvegostomig as adjuvant treatment for high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial cancer after neoadjuvant therapy and surgery. Around 915 participants are planned, with disease-free survival as the primary endpoint. This is trial initiation, not a positive comparative efficacy result.

items.title_zh: 第一三共抗 CD25 ADC DS1025 完成 I 期试验首例给药
items.summary: 第一三共8月28日宣布，新型抗 CD25 ADC DS1025 在晚期或转移性实体瘤患者中完成 I 期试验首例给药。该候选药物旨在作用于肿瘤微环境中的调节性 T 细胞。剂量递增研究计划在包括日本的亚洲及欧洲招募最多45人，重点评估安全性、耐受性并探索疗效。首例给药代表进入早期临床验证，不代表安全性和疗效已经确立。
items.summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced first-patient dosing in a phase 1 study of the anti-CD25 ADC DS1025 on August 28. The candidate is designed to target regulatory T cells in the tumor microenvironment. The dose-escalation study plans up to 45 patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors across Asia, including Japan, and Europe, assessing safety, tolerability and preliminary activity. First dosing is an early development milestone, not established efficacy or safety.

items.summary: 卫材与渤健9月3日公告，中国 NMPA 批准 LEQEMBI 皮下自动注射制剂作为早期阿尔茨海默病的起始治疗，用于轻度认知障碍或轻度痴呆阶段。每周皮下注射是现有药物的新给药方式，计划在截至2027年3月的2026财年于中国上市。获批不等于已经上市；治疗仍有相关监测要求，不能将自动注射理解为无需医疗管理。
items.summary_en: Eisai and Biogen announced Chinese approval of the LEQEMBI subcutaneous autoinjector for initiation treatment of early Alzheimer's disease on September 3, covering mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia stages. Weekly subcutaneous dosing is a new formulation of the existing medicine. A Chinese launch is planned during fiscal 2026, ending March 2027. Approval is not proof of commercial availability, and the autoinjector does not remove treatment monitoring requirements.
items.reviewer_notes: 已读卫材与渤健联合官方公告。

items.summary: 田边制药8月18日宣布，已签订协议，将口服候选药 dersimelagon（MT-7117）的全球开发、商业化等权利转让给 LEO Pharma。该药针对伴光敏症状的 EPP 和 XLP，6月30日已向 FDA 提交上市申请，公告时仍在争取批准。正在进行的试验将按计划继续，并拟在适当阶段移交；不能把签约或申报写成已经获批上市。
items.summary_en: Tanabe announced an agreement on August 18 to transfer global development, commercialization and other rights to oral dersimelagon, MT-7117, to LEO Pharma. The award ceremony was scheduled for September 17 in New York; this is a research award, not a new drug approval or partnership.

items.summary_en: Kissei announced publication of phase 3 BOND-003 cohort C results for the oncolytic-virus candidate CG0070 in The Lancet Oncology on August 17. The single-arm study involves BCG-unresponsive non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer with carcinoma in situ. Publication is not comparative proof of superiority or regulatory approval. Kissei holds relevant exclusive rights in 20 Asian countries and territories excluding China; a Japanese filing remained a future step in the announcement.

items.summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced Chinese NMPA approval of Enhertu plus pertuzumab as first-line therapy for unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer, based on DESTINY-Breast09. The August 12 English and August 17 Japanese releases cover the same approval and should not be interpreted as separate milestones. They provide no evidence of an ACRO purchasing relationship.
